title: Vertical landing page for salons
rationale: Commercial SERP for the salon query rewards vertical pages; no vertical page exists.
acceptance: Given a visitor opens /salons, When the page loads, Then it shows salon-specific features, pricing link and a signup call to action
Given /salons is fetched, When the HTML is read, Then it has a unique title and H1

title: Claim the free vendor profile on the review platform
rationale: Review platforms rank for the category query; a free basic profile exists.
acceptance: Done when the vendor profile is claimed and lists the free plan, without incentivised reviews

title: Attribute signups to landing pages
rationale: Owner reports signups but not their source pages.
acceptance: Given a visitor signs up, When the signup event fires, Then it carries the landing page path
